title: Inventory stock adjustment calls an endpoint that does not exist
evidence: api.post('/inventory/adjust', ...) at inventory/page.tsx:107; backend/cmd/api/main.go registers no /api/v1/inventory/* route (363 routes extracted; none match). Page also has no MODULE_IDS gate.
suspected_root_cause: UI built ahead of backend; backend only has GET /products/alerts/low-stock and reports/inventory
recommended_fix: Implement POST adjust endpoint with RBAC and movement audit trail (inventoryMovementRepo exists, main.go:136) or hide the dialog
required_tests: contract test: adjust returns 2xx and writes a movement
UI e2e: adjust stock then product quantity changes

title: POS offline replay and cash auto-pay can duplicate orders or leave cash orders unpaid silently
evidence: usePOSOffline.ts:174-177 calls posApi.createOrder then updateOrderPaymentStatus inside one try; if the second call fails the catch increments retryCount and keeps the already-created order queued, so the next replay creates it again. No idempotency key in the payload (posApi.ts:188-213). Online path pos/page.tsx:304-311 swallows the payment-mark failure (debugError only), then shows success and prints the receipt.
suspected_root_cause: Two non-atomic calls orchestrated on the client; no client request id
recommended_fix: Send paid state in the create call or use a server idempotency key (client UUID stored in queue item); record create-succeeded state in the queue; surface payment-mark failure to the cashier
required_tests: unit: replay with failing payment-status does not re-create order
e2e: offline cash order syncs exactly once

title: pos-sw.js background sync posts to the wrong origin without auth or tenant headers
evidence: pos-sw.js:154 fetch(API_PREFIX + 'public/orders') with API_PREFIX='/api/v1/' is relative to the dashboard origin (:3002) while config.ts:15 apiUrl is http://localhost:8080/api/v1. Request has credentials:'include' but no Authorization/X-Tenant-ID/X-Restaurant-ID (token is in localStorage, unreachable from SW). next.config.js defines no rewrites. SW also never marks cash orders paid and throws on first failure.
suspected_root_cause: SW written assuming a same-origin API proxy that does not exist
recommended_fix: Remove SW sync and rely on in-page replay, or have SW read token/tenant from IndexedDB and use absolute API URL; keep a single replay owner to avoid double submit
required_tests: assert queued POST hits API origin with auth headers

title: pos-sw.js caches authenticated API GET responses keyed by URL only and never purges on logout
evidence: networkFirst() stores every OK GET whose pathname starts with /api/v1/ (cross-origin :8080 matches too) in 'pos-cache-v1'; key ignores Authorization/tenant. Cache is deleted only when CACHE_NAME changes (activate handler).
recommended_fix: Do not cache API responses in the SW, or key by tenant+user and clear on logout via postMessage

title: Logout is incomplete and routes to a non-existent page
evidence: handleLogout() calls logout() (sets user/token null) then router.push('/{locale}/auth/login'); the dashboard app has no auth/login route (only auth/callback and auth/super-admin-login); effect at :70-73 does the same. Not cleared: permissionCache ('current_user'), 'pos-storage' (cart, held orders, customer name/phone), 'kds-bootstrap-snapshot-v1', theme-builder-storage, preferences-storage, sessionStorage impersonation_token, IndexedDB pos-offline-db and kds-offline-db, SW caches. (Blocked-screen logouts redirect to landing; only the sidebar/avatar path is affected.)
suspected_root_cause: Logout implemented as store reset only
recommended_fix: Central logout(): clear all app storage keys, IndexedDB and SW caches, end impersonation, redirect to landing login
required_tests: second user login sees no previous cart/permissions

title: Access tokens and user JSON are passed in URL query strings and logged
evidence: auth_token/auth_user/impersonation_token/token/user are read from window.location.search; super-admin one-time token is in the query. KDS WS URL = base + '?token=' + JWT and debugLog prints the full URL (:132). JWT persisted in localStorage 'auth-storage'. test-url page echoes query values.
suspected_root_cause: Cross-app SSO via redirect query params
recommended_fix: Use one-time code exchange + HttpOnly cookie or URL fragment; WS short-lived ticket; never log URLs containing tokens
required_tests: no token in access logs/referrer test

title: Impersonation uses a dummy bearer 'impersonated'; many call sites ignore the impersonation header
evidence: setAuth(user,'impersonated') stores a fake bearer. Only the lib/api.ts interceptor swaps in X-Impersonation-Token. Raw-fetch pages (users, roles, account, appearance, DashboardLayout prefs), themeApi's own axios client and the KDS WS all send 'Bearer impersonated'. 401 under impersonation never logs out; sessionStorage impersonation_token is never removed (no removeItem in src).
recommended_fix: Single shared HTTP client; end-impersonation action calling /impersonation/end and clearing state; visible banner

title: Three HTTP access paths with inconsistent auth, 401 handling and error shapes
evidence: axios 'api' (6s timeout, GET de-dupe, tenant headers, 401 redirect); a second axios instance in themeApi.ts (no tenant/impersonation headers, 401 only removes auth-storage); about 21 raw fetch() sites (settings/users 9, roles 5, account 2, appearance 2, DashboardLayout, auth provider, TenantSelectorModal) with no timeout/401 handling and hand-parsed response shapes (data | data.data | data.users). No error normalizer; pages read error.response?.data?.error ad hoc.
recommended_fix: One client plus typed error normalizer (code/message/fieldErrors); replace raw fetch; one 401 policy
required_tests: lint rule forbidding raw fetch to API

title: next build fails the type gate; static causes found (unresolved imports, undeclared deps, stray dirs inside tsconfig scope)
evidence: tsc could not be run (no typescript binary installed in the checkout), so the ~705 count is UNVERIFIED here. Statically verified: unresolved '@/lib/api-client' (lib/hooks/use-theme.ts:3), '@/hooks/useAuth' (TenantSelectorModal.tsx:5), '@/pages/heavy-route' (usePreloadRoute.ts:5); '@radix-ui/react-tabs' imported (ui/tabs.tsx:4) but not in package.json; 'qrcode' imported (tables/page.tsx:15) with no @types/qrcode; @playwright/test imported from tests/ (inside tsconfig include) but not declared; typescript.ignoreBuildErrors is enabled only via NEXT_IGNORE_BUILD_ERRORS=true (next.config.js:11), i.e. Docker prod builds bypass the gate.
suspected_root_cause: Type gate bypassed by env flag; tsconfig include '**/*.ts(x)' sweeps stray root dirs, tests and dead files
recommended_fix: Fix error categories (see DASHBOARD-COMPLETE-AUDIT.md section 4); narrow tsconfig include/exclude; run tsc --noEmit in CI; remove env bypass

title: Stray app-root dirs duplicate src/ and are type-checked but largely unreferenced
evidence: components/ (14 files), lib/hooks/use-theme.ts and i18n/request.ts (re-export of ../src/i18n/request) sit beside src/. No file in src imports components/theme-editor or components/component-manager (heuristic import scan). section-editor.tsx:194-195 uses formData.background_image which is not in ThemeSection (component-sidebar.tsx:7-19); theme-editor.tsx:19,61 destructures updateTheme from the broken lib/hooks/use-theme.ts.
recommended_fix: Delete, or move into src/ and fix; exclude tests/ from the app tsconfig

title: Workspace package wiring is inconsistent (ui, ui-themes, types, constants)
evidence: Code imports '@pos-saas/ui' (4 files in app-root components/) and '@pos-saas/ui-themes' (LivePreview.tsx:6, EditorPreview.tsx:6) but package.json declares ui-components and ui-themes, not ui. tsconfig paths map ui, ui-components, theme, types, constants but not ui-themes; frontend/packages has only theme, ui, ui-components (no types/constants); @pos-saas/ui-themes lives in frontend/layers/ui-themes. transpilePackages lists only '@pos-saas/ui' and '@pos-saas/types'.
recommended_fix: Align package.json deps, tsconfig paths and transpilePackages with actual workspace packages

title: Theme version rollback shows success but does nothing
evidence: handleRollback: the API call is commented out ('When backend history endpoint is ready...') and then toast.success('Version restored successfully') runs. Backend has only GET /admin/themes/{id}/history (main.go:1469), no rollback route.
recommended_fix: Implement backend rollback and client call, or disable the button; never show false success
required_tests: e2e: restore version changes the active theme

title: themeApi defines functions for unregistered backend routes (not called by UI)
evidence: export (POST /admin/themes/{id}/export), import (POST /admin/themes/import -> only GET/PUT/DELETE {id} exist, method mismatch), components CRUD and reorder (/admin/themes/{id}/components...), GET /public/component-library: none registered in main.go; their handlers sit in theme_routes_v2.go behind //go:build legacy. No UI caller found by grep; theme-builder import page uses createTheme instead.
suspected_root_cause: Dead API surface from legacy v2 design
recommended_fix: Delete the dead functions or implement the endpoints

title: Many dashboard pages have no page-level permission gate; backend for several modules is auth-only
evidence: Pages without useHasPermission/MODULE_IDS: drivers (3), categories (3), inventory, theme-builder (5), rbac/roles, settings/billing, accounting/advanced, hr contracts/insurance/performance/resignations/training (5), reports/financial/* (9). Sidebar hides links via checkPermission only (drivers use ORDERS). Backend (main.go:671-675, 1397-1407, 1462-1469): /admin/drivers, /categories, /admin/themes, /users use wrapProtected (authentication only). No Next middleware exists (no src/middleware*), so gating is client-side.
recommended_fix: Server-side module permission on all mutating routes; shared RequirePermission wrapper for pages
required_tests: role matrix e2e: cashier cannot CRUD drivers/categories/themes

title: Permission cache is not per-user, persists, is never cleared; each hook fetches separately; client role fallback grants KDS ADMIN
evidence: CURRENT_USER_PERMISSION_CACHE_KEY='current_user' (useRbac.ts:18) stored via PermissionCache (memory + storage); no clear() call outside tests (grep). useHasPermission seeds state from the cache (stale after user switch). Each useHasPermission instance calls rbacApi.checkPermission (one request per hook per page). applyKDSRoleFallback grants KDS=ADMIN for privileged roles read from localStorage (UI only).
recommended_fix: Key by user+tenant; clear on logout; single permissions fetch in a context provider

title: Two parallel i18n systems, missing keys, RTL scoped to an inner div
evidence: next-intl useTranslations in 14 pages (hr advanced 5, reports/financial 8, reports/hr) vs custom createTranslator with inline English fallbacks in most other pages. en.json and ar.json each 1719 keys (parity OK, no mojibake-looking values) but 36 literal keys used in code are absent from en.json (pos.settings* 21 in pos/settings/page.tsx, bankAccountMessages.* 8, kds.* 3, Sidebar 3, DashboardLayout 1) so Arabic users see hard-coded English; 101 ar values equal en. Root html lang='en' is hard-coded and dir/lang are set on an inner div (layout.tsx:49-63), so Radix portals (Dialog/Select render into body) likely stay LTR in Arabic [needs runtime confirmation]; preferencesStore also writes documentElement.dir from saved user language, a second source of truth beside the URL locale. No middleware: '/' always redirects to '/en'. 109 files still use physical ml-/mr-/pl-/pr-/text-left/right classes.
recommended_fix: Use next-intl only; set html lang/dir from locale in root layout; add missing keys; logical CSS (ms-/me-)
required_tests: ar locale visual regression incl. dialogs

title: POS tax rate hard-coded 14% client-side; payment model minimal; product list capped
evidence: TAX_RATE=0.14 drives displayed subtotal/tax/total and the receipt (buildReceiptData). The create payload carries no prices (good, server prices) but the receipt total can diverge from the server total. VALID_PAYMENT_METHODS lacks 'online' though the API type allows it. No cash-tendered/change/split payment; cash is always auto-marked paid. getProducts requests page_size 500 (silent truncation for larger menus). Cart and held orders persist in localStorage 'pos-storage'.
recommended_fix: Use server totals for the receipt; tenant-configurable tax; tender/change; pagination
required_tests: receipt total equals server total test

title: Financial amounts computed and sent from the client; revenue tile from one page of orders; mixed currency symbols
evidence: InvoiceForm computes tax_amount/discount_amount/line_total with unrounded floats and posts them (mapLineToPayload:636-650); JournalEntryForm balance check uses float epsilon 0.001; dashboard recentPaidRevenue sums totals of one recent-orders page, not a server aggregate; orders pages format '$' (orders/page.tsx:503, orders/[id]/page.tsx:372-392) while accounting/reports use EGP; financial report PDFs are rasterized with html2canvas+jspdf.
suspected_root_cause: No shared money utility; server trust
recommended_fix: Server recomputes and rejects mismatches; integer minor units; server-side aggregates; one currency formatter from tenant settings

title: KDS WebSocket has no client resync or stale detection and no server RBAC; client-side auto-bump; snapshot persists order data
evidence: Server pings every 54s (backend/internal/handler/ws/kds_hub.go:18) but the client has no stale-connection detection; cross-ref: kds_ws_handler.go validates JWT from ?token= but has no KDS permission/role check (grep for permission/role = none) and CheckOrigin returns true (:83-86). Reconnect backoff 1s..10s without jitter; on reconnect no REST refetch (poll runs only while !isConnected after POLL_FALLBACK_DELAY). Auto-bump timer (kds/page.tsx:126-147) bumps from the browser every 15s when auto_bump_minutes>0: several stations double-act, stops when the tab closes. KDS snapshot with orders stored in localStorage 'kds-bootstrap-snapshot-v1' (not cleared on logout). Unknown message types ignored silently.
recommended_fix: Server-side auto-bump; client resync-on-open and stale detection; KDS permission check and origin allowlist on WS; clear snapshot on logout
required_tests: WS reconnect e2e recovers missed order

title: Authenticated app HTML cached publicly for 1h; CSP permissive
evidence: '/:path*' gets Cache-Control public,max-age=3600,s-maxage=3600; CSP has 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' and connect-src https: http: ws: wss:. Pages are client-rendered shells (no SSR user data verified) so exposure is limited.
recommended_fix: private/no-store for dashboard routes; tighten CSP to the API origin

title: Debug/test artifacts and duplicate routes shipped
evidence: /{locale}/test-url is routable outside DashboardAuthProvider; '?debug=true' branch in the locale home page; two differing auth callback pages (/auth/callback and /{locale}/auth/callback); ar.json.bak-mojibake kept inside src.
recommended_fix: Remove from production build

title: About 39 files appear unreferenced, including ServiceWorkerProvider/public/sw.js (never registered) and NotificationBell
evidence: Heuristic import scan (approximate). ServiceWorkerProvider is never mounted; if it were, sw.js install precaches '/layout.js' and '/styles.css' (not present) so cache.addAll would reject. TenantStatusProvider unused; tenant status is checked once at mount (DashboardAuthProvider).
recommended_fix: Delete or wire; add knip/ts-prune to CI

title: Global 6s axios timeout applies to reports/exports; 100ms GET de-dupe shares promises
evidence: DEFAULT_API_TIMEOUT_MS=6000 unless NEXT_PUBLIC_API_TIMEOUT_MS is set; blob export calls (accountingAdvancedApi.ts:201, reportsApi export) inherit it unless overridden (not verified per call). De-dupe key ignores headers.
recommended_fix: Per-call timeouts for exports

title: POS creates orders via an unauthenticated public route that trusts caller-supplied tenant headers
evidence: posApi.createOrder -> POST /public/orders (order_source:'pos'). main.go:472 wraps only TenantContextMiddleware; tenant.go:38-66 falls back to X-Tenant-ID/X-Restaurant-ID headers when no JWT claims exist. The dashboard interceptor itself sends these headers (api.ts:169-190). No server-side ORDERS WRITE check for POS creation was found. Handler-level validation not read; needs backend auditor confirmation.
suspected_root_cause: POS reused the public ordering endpoint
recommended_fix: Authenticated staff order endpoint with RBAC; public endpoint resolves tenant from slug/signed table token
required_tests: unauthenticated POST with arbitrary X-Tenant-ID is rejected for order_source pos

title: Table QR URLs use one global restaurant domain and sequential table ids
evidence: buildTableMenuUrl => NEXT_PUBLIC_RESTAURANT_DOMAIN + '/{locale}/table/{tableID}/menu' (deploy-time single domain, not tenant slug/subdomain); table id is the DB integer; public GET /public/table/{id}/info (IP rate limit only) takes the bare id. Wrong-tenant QR or cross-tenant guessing in multi-tenant deployments.
recommended_fix: Per-tenant domain/slug in URL; unguessable table token

title: No global error normalization; pages surface raw backend error strings
evidence: Pages toast error.response?.data?.error directly (inventory:116) or concatenate 'Failed to load users: ' + err.message; backend itself returns raw err.Error() (see QA-002 in issues-quality.json).
recommended_fix: Central error mapper with i18n codes

title: Order PDF export injects unescaped customer-supplied text into DOM; CSV export has no quote/formula escaping
evidence: generateOrderHTML interpolates item.product_name and item.special_instructions (customer-entered on public orders) into a template string that is assigned to tempDiv.innerHTML (pdf-export.ts:67) inside the authenticated dashboard origin; JWT is in localStorage so script execution would expose it. By contrast POS receipt escapes (usePOSPrint.ts:197). CSV rows wrap fields in quotes without escaping embedded quotes or leading = + - @ (pdf-export.ts:179-182) and only export the current page of orders.
recommended_fix: Escape all interpolated values (or build DOM with textContent); CSV-escape and neutralize formula prefixes; use server export
required_tests: unit test: product_name with is inert in PDF HTML
